title: Mirages. On Anthropomorphism in Dialogue Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and theoretical analysis of how assigning binary genders and predominantly female voices to conversational agents reinforces gender stereotypes and subservient roles.
Literature review and theoretical analysis of how narratives around artificial intelligence center whiteness, often excluding or erasing people of color from technological representation.

Literature review and theoretical analysis of how dialogue systems prioritize standard, affluent American dialects, leading to poor recognition of other socio-linguistic norms and forcing marginalized users to code-switch.
